broker.name: Ultima Markets
broker.tagline: On its own site since 2016. Its site names FSC (Mauritius) and FCA. Rules depend on where you live. Advertised leverage: Up to 1:2000.
broker.about: Ultima Markets says it has operated since 2016. The pages checked do not name one headquarters. Account names on its site include Standard, ECN, Standard Cent, ECN Cent, and Ultimate. Platforms named there include MT4, MT5, Webtrader, and Mobile Apps. The site names these regulators: FSC (Mauritius) and FCA. The company on an account depends on where the client lives. Minimum deposit is not a single number on the pages that loaded. The highest leverage figure taken from those pages is Up to 1:2000. Leverage increases losses as well as gains.
broker.regulators_note: The company behind an account depends on where you live. FSC (Mauritius): Ultima Markets (Mauritius) Ltd, GB 23201593. FCA.

broker.leverage_note: Leverage increases losses as well as gains, and you can lose more than you deposit. The highest figure on this card is the highest number this broker advertises. It is not the cap on every account. The cap depends on the company, the product and where you live.

other_fees.label: Minimum deposit
other_fees.note: Account types page lists a minimum deposit of 50 USD on Standard, ECN, Standard Cent and ECN Cent. Ultimate also lists $50 USD, with a note that a cumulative deposit of $1,000 USD is required to activate that account. Because the activation amount differs, no single minimum is recorded.

other_fees.label: Willis Towers Watson insurance
other_fees.value: Claims eligibility up to US$1,000,000 per account
other_fees.note: About page says all clients are protected under insurance coverage provided by Willis Towers Watson (WTW).

other_fees.label: Financial Commission compensation fund
other_fees.note: Covers judgements if a member refuses to comply. Does not apply to losses from the client's own trading decisions. Membership is not a government licence.

_notes.fetch_notes: Homepage, about, account types, FCA news and Financial Commission pages fetched on 2026-10-11. Founded year is from 'Trusted Since 2016' and 'Established since 2016'. Mauritius licence and registered office are from the June 2026 client agreement PDF on the official site. The FCA news page says the firm has FCA authorisation but does not give a reference number or UK entity name. A search index quote of the legal page mentioned Ultima Markets UK Limited reference 470325, but the live WebFetch body and a direct HTML download of that page did not contain that sentence, so the number was left null. Legal documents page fetch did not list licence numbers. No client promotion with terms was found on the pages fetched.
